task.description: The title of the task, for example "(Task) 743 Shard Invocations".

make-ready.say: {{task}} is done. For more work, make a new task that continues it with sk-proj-supersede_task.
{{task}} is closed. Work on the task in its superseded-by field, or make a new task.

report.description: The report that the task made, for example "(Report) 031 Title". Set it in the report step.

next.interactive: Implement {{task}}: tick each checkbox, write the Task Log, and commit the WIP of each repo in git-repos.
next.headless: Read {{task}} fully and implement it: tick each checkbox, write the Task Log, commit the WIP of each repo in git-repos, and keep the phase and the progress of the session current. When blocked, use a deferred request.

steps.title: Report
steps.next: Make a report when {{task}} asks for one, or when the work found something to keep. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} report='(Report) NNN Title'. Else skip this step: flint shard step skip report --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

next.interactive: Set {{task}} to review, give the person a summary, and refine it until the person confirms.
next.headless: Check each checkbox of {{task}}, set it to review, and write the last Task Log line. Mark this step done, and close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the review_task command of the close in the result, and return with flint orbh session return --finish. Never pass --with task-confirm.

steps.title: Close
steps.next: When the person confirms, run flint shard proj task-close {{task}}. When the session ends with the task, use flint orbh close --with task-confirm instead.

behaviours.say: {{task}} is in review. Close with --with task-confirm to move it to done, or keep it in review.
{{task}} is still open: it is not in review. Move it to review when the work is done, or return with --with task-defer="<reason>" to defer it.
